sn56.61:1.1: atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsuṃ āropetvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
sn56.61:1.3: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ. yo vā’yaṃ mayā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito, ayaṃ vā mahāpaṭhavī”ti?
sn56.61:1.4: etadeva bhante, bahutaraṃ yadidaṃ mahāpaṭhavī, appamattako, yaṃ bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito.
sn56.61:1.5: saṅkhampi na upeti, upanidhimpi na upeti, kalabhāgampi na upeti mahāpaṭhaviṃ upanidhāya bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropitoti.
sn56.61:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye manussesu paccājāyanti. atha kho eteva bahutarā sattā ye aññatra manussehi paccājāyanti.
sn56.61:3.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
